value.rationale: Theorem 10 is presented as an if-and-only-if characterization of controlled K-fusion frames. Requiring synthesis onto all of H collapses the K-specific range condition toward the ordinary fusion-frame condition and excludes elementary projection K-fusion frames. The repair is exact, removes the unnecessary closed-range hypothesis, and identifies surjective K as the precise regime in which the printed surjectivity statement becomes valid.
